Yet, so far the community was mostly happening on our [url="https://discord.gg/TH4qT3nQmu"]Discord[/url]. With the new update you can upload your designs for everyone else to find and visit. I'm super excited to look at all your designs there and hope it can be a source of inspiration for your own![/p][p]As this is the first online feature, I'd love to hear your feedback, thoughts and ideas on this step :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157920/46e52e8be8ff902b6505f4e133b54738e88a9e0e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What else is new?[/h3][p]🌧️ Let it rain! Now occasionally it may start to rain for some extra cozy atmosphere. Can be turned off in the settings though if you prefer it sunny![/p][p]☀ 30+ new balcony items with it's own new category![/p][p]🪴 A new plant expansion with more variety and finally some hanging plants![/p][p]🌸 Flower expansion with 20+ flowers and even some loose flowers that you can out into vases yourself![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157920/d8d7ac0652d756e0a417aa1b111a336f15eff464.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What's coming next?[/h3][p]One thing I hear from players all the time is that they want more clutter. Well, I hear you! The new balcony items are just the beginning and we plan to add 150 more within the next two months![/p][p]Additionally we're gonna continue to work hard on the creative mode in which you can design your own apartment layouts. Planned to come this fall![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for playing. I really hope you're gonna enjoy the update and I'm super excited for your feedback♥️[/p][p][/p][p]-Niklas[/p]

notes.title: Fix Resolution Issues & Backup System
notes.content:
A small update fixing the issue that the game launches with a weird resolution for some players. Also worked on save game stability as some players reported issues and added a backup system in case a save game gets corrupted.

In the AppData/Local/SmallSpaces/Saved/SaveGames folder there will now be BackupFiles created everytime you save a level. To use them, just change the file name to SaveGameRelease and remove the SaveGameRelease file from the folder (or give it a new name).

Hope this doesn't become relevant for most players and I also put some work into making save games generally more stable, but I want to make sure your creations always stay safe <3

notes.title: Small Spaces hits 10,000 players! What's coming next?
notes.content:
[h1]Wow![/h1]
In less than a week, over 10,000 of you have already picked up Small Spaces. I'm so happy to see you're enjoying the game and your support means a ton! Ultimately it helps me to continue putting all my time into working on Small Spaces and I'm beyond excited to ship the content updates to you that are already in the making!

[h3]🚀 The Roadmap[/h3]

As some of you have already seen on [url=https://niklastomkowitz.notion.site/Small-Spaces-Roadmap-1cb2ac82e0cd801091f8f181a13bbd1f?p=1cb2ac82e0cd80dab9e3d9d8bba5fa05&pm=s&pvs=31][b]Notion[/b][/url], I put together a roadmap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157920/50672dddab4db9ce0d970c4ca82a715f0c043d7b.png[/img]

⛱️ Right now, the biggest upcoming feature is going to be [b]Sandbox mode[/b]. You’ll be able to design your own apartment layouts and levels using the level modules from each theme! This is going to be a big step for the game, and it’ll take a lot of work to get right — but I seriously can’t wait for the first playtest sessions.

I’m so excited to hear what you think and what you'd love to see next. The current roadmap is a tentative plan that will evolve based on what’s important to you - I keep saying it, but this is a community game!

[h3]✨ Got thoughts, suggestions, or wild ideas?  [/h3]

Come hang out on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FnMb24WWfkG][b]my Discord[/b][/url]! That’s where I’m gathering all your feedback and insights. Also it's a fun place with people full of creative energy :)

There’s still so much more I want to add, improve, and build — and knowing that thousands of you are decorating, experimenting, and finding calm in designing these beautiful homes, makes it all worth it!

Thank you for being here 💛

– Niklas

notes.title: Early Access vs. Demo: What changed? Everything.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

If you played the Small Spaces demo — thank you. Over [b]100,000 of you[/b] gave it a try, and your feedback helped shape what the game is today.

Since the demo, the game has grown a lot! More levels, more furniture, better usability, quality-of-life features, performance improvements and more. My goal was to bring the demo to a point where it can live up to its potential and I’m so excited you’re all enjoying the Early Access🥳

[h3]👀 What’s in the Early Access?[/h3]
🛋️ 9 unique apartments across 3 cities: New York, Berlin and Tokyo, fully reworked
🎨 500+ furniture and decor items with unlockable content — from a variety of comfy beds to kitchen utensils and sewing accessories
🖌️ Paint walls, floors & surfaces (yes, now you can paint the whole room with just one click!)
👀 First-person walk mode — see it like someone living there
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Unique stories and objectives for each level
🎁 Progression & shop system to unlock more tools — earn stars and spend them on new furniture packs, more materials, and modules to customize your space even more
🎧 Performance options, improved visuals, new music — you can adjust the graphic settings to enjoy Small Spaces on different machines

[h3]🤩 Your creativity is out of this world[/h3]
I’ve been constantly blown away by the amazing designs you’ve been sharing on [url=https://discord.gg/nMb24WWfkG]Discord[/url] — it’s so inspiring and genuinely rewarding to see! Your creativity never ceases to amaze me. Here are just a few of my favorites so far:

[i]by April Wang[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157920/7fd6801c89de96920a1b182198322cc2b04f5206.png[/img]

[h3]🙏 Thank you for your positive reviews[/h3]
I’m beyond grateful that Small Spaces is currently sitting at [b]95% positive[/b] on Steam.
You’ve been kind, honest, and inspiring with all of your feedback — and we’re already working hard on the next updates, adding what’s missing and improving what can be improved.

If you enjoyed the demo, but weren’t sure what’s next — now’s a great time to step back in.

Thanks again for being here 💛
 — Niklas

notes.title: Small Spaces is now out in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The day is finally here, [b]Small Spaces is out now in Early Access![/b] 🎉
It’s a little surreal to hit “publish” after a year of long hours of development, feedback, playtests, polish, and many sleepless nights. But I’m so happy and grateful to finally be sharing the game with you.

This project has grown so much thanks to your support. Whether you played the demo, left a review, sent in feedback, or joined one of our 1:1 interviews, thank you. You’ve helped shape Small Spaces into what it is today, and your input has been invaluable in figuring out what makes the game fun, cozy, and satisfying to play. I hope you will continue to share your thoughts with me — that's why I’d love to invite you to our [url=https://discord.gg/nMb24WWfkG]Discord server[/url]!

[previewyoutube=1X3C5r97gc4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]🔍 What's new?[/h3]
There’s a lot more waiting for you in the Early Access version compared to the demo!

🧩 Nine handcrafted apartment levels, each with a unique layout, vibe, and objectives.
🪑 Over 500 decor and furniture items to mix and match.
🖌️ Material painting system for walls, floors, and accents.
🛠️ Modular building tools including kitchen cabinets, stairs, wall panels and more.
🎁 Shop to unlock new items as you complete levels.
🎶 A first set of music pieces to support your design flow.

Also I want to mention that I was not all alone in this journey. Amit Mechlovitz did a fantastic job designing hundreds of beautifiul furniture assets and decoration pieces, and Mohammed Hanafy handcrafted every single illutration you can find in the game.

Both artists helped shape my vision and in the end allow the game to look the way it does. I hope you’ll enjoy them just as much!

[h3]🚀 What’s next?[/h3]
The Early Access roadmap is now live — you can check it out over on [url=https://niklastomkowitz.notion.site/Small-Spaces-Roadmap-1cb2ac82e0cd801091f8f181a13bbd1f]Notion[/url]. It’s where I’ll be sharing upcoming features, improvements, and ideas I’m currently exploring. I'm so excited to hear what you think what you would like to see in the game next and the roadmap will absolutely reflect that. This is just the beginning — I have lots planned, and I hope you’ll be part of the journey!

[h3]🎁 Cozy bundles for launch[/h3]
To celebrate the release, Small Spaces is part of three lovely bundles alongside some of the coziest games out there — perfect for anyone who loves relaxing vibes, creativity, and a touch of wholesome fun.

🌿 Urban Jungle — Where you turn your living space into a dreamy green oasis in this plant-decorating gem. It's all about calm, creativity, and cozy interiors, just like Small Spaces!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53972/

📦 Sticky Business — Design your own stickers, run a small business, and fulfill cute customer orders. It’s pure serotonin in game form!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53973/

🪴 Spirit City: Lofi Sessions — A cozy productivity companion where you can vibe to lofi music, set goals, and chill with adorable spirit creatures while getting things done.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54161/

All bundles come with additional discounts, so it’s a great chance to grab some cozy favorites and support fellow indie devs we admire.

Thank you again for all your support, kind messages, and enthusiasm. I’m incredibly proud of how far Small Spaces has come — and even more excited about where it’s going.

See you in-game!
— Niklas

notes.title: Just 1 day to go!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I can’t believe it, but Small Spaces is launching tomorrow, and I wanted to share some final details with you before the big day! 🎉

[h3]🗓️ Release Date & Time[/h3]
Small Spaces will be available in Early Access on May 27, 2025 at 3 PM CEST!

Here’s what that looks like in other time zones:
6 AM PDT (West Coast US)
9 AM EDT (East Coast US)
1 PM GMT
9 PM CST (China Standard Time)
10 PM JST (Japan)
11 PM AEST (Australia)

[h3]💸 Launch Price[/h3]
The game will be priced at $12.99 USD / €12,79 EUR, and there’ll be a 10% launch discount valid for the first two weeks. Don’t forget to check your local pricing on Steam!

[h3]🛣️ What’s Next?[/h3]
I’ll also be sharing a roadmap on release day so you’ll have a better idea of what’s coming during Early Access, including features we’re planning to expand and new content already in the works.

[h3]💬 Join Our Discord![/h3]
I'd love to have you in our [url=https://discord.gg/nMb24WWfkG]Discord server[/url]! It’s the best place to share your ideas, help shape future updates, hang out with other cozy builder fans, and just chat with me directly.

I’m so grateful for your support and excitement. It’s been amazing seeing the community grow ahead of launch, and I truly can’t wait for you to start designing, decorating, and making magic in Small Spaces ✨

Talk again very soon, and see you on May 27!
— Niklas

notes.title: Small Spaces is releasing on May 27!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It’s been a whirlwind of development, playtests, polish passes (and lots of coffee and green tea), and I’m incredibly excited to finally share this with you:

[b]Small Spaces will officially launch in Early Access on May 27, 2025! 🥳[/b]

It feels a little surreal to be writing this. It’s been such a journey to build Small Spaces and I’m really proud of how far it’s come. I can tell you I’ve poured a lot of love into this cozy little builder, and I can’t wait for you to finally get your hands on it!

At the same time it also feels like this is only the beginning. I have so many ideas on how to expand the game and I plan to take the next 9 months to do so. I'll share more details on what that means soon!

Until then, here’s a tiny preview of what’s waiting for you in the Early Access version:

🧩 Nine handcrafted apartment levels, each with a unique layout, vibe, and objectives.
🪑 Over 500 decor and furniture items to mix and match.
🖌️ Material painting system for walls, floors, and accents.
🛠️ Modular building tools including kitchen cabinets, stairs, wall panels and more.
🎁 Shop to unlock new items as you complete levels.
🎶 A first set of music pieces to support your design flow.

Stay tuned, I’ve got more release details and sneak peeks coming your way in the next few days!

Thank you so much for your support, patience, and kind messages. It truly means the world 💛

Talk to you again very soon!

— Niklas

notes.title: What’s new in development?
notes.content:
It’s been a busy and exciting time, so I thought I’d take a moment to share what I’ve been working on behind the scenes. [b]We’re getting closer and closer to the release of Small Spaces[/b], and it’s been amazing to watch everything slowly come together!

Here’s a quick look at what’s been taking up most of my time recently during development:


[list]
[*] 🎨 [b]Big material feature update[/b] — you’ll be able to paint entire walls and floors at once, and choose different color variations in the options menu.
[*]  🗂️ [b]Better asset organization[/b] — all items are now sorted into subcategories, making it much easier to find exactly what you need.
[*]  🧵 [b]New decoration assets[/b] — added some cozy sewing- and music-themed props for new level objectives.
[*] 🛒 [b]Fully functioning shop system[/b] (unlock as you play) — as you progress through the game, you’ll gain access to new materials and decorations to expand your creative options.
[*] 🛋️ [b]Modern Japanese furniture pack[/b] — 90 new items to use in your designs.
[*]🪑 [b]Scandinavian furniture pack[/b] — 75 new unique items, many with color variations.
[*] ✨ [b]Redesigned the Berlin kit [/b]— all assets and levels have a fully fresh look. 
[/list]
And last but not least:
[list][*]🛠️ [b]Bug fixing[/b] — I’ve spent a lot of time fixing bugs and polishing things up to make sure everything runs just right 🥳
[/list]

I can’t wait to share more updates soon as we get closer to launch!
Thanks so much for all your support — it truly keeps me going ❤️

I’m also happy to share that Small Spaces is taking part in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/polishconstitutiondays2025][b]Polish Constitution Days[/b][/url]. Check out some awesome games created or published by Polish studios :)

Talk to you again soon!
Niklas

notes.title: What will Small Spaces be? Let’s Talk!
notes.content:
I am happy to announce that Small Spaces now has a publisher! I’ve partnered with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/prettysoon][b]Pretty Soon[/b][/url], a publisher that works with solo devs and small teams. It’s great to finally have some additional help and we’ll be working together to make Small Spaces the best game it can be.

To do that, we’d love to learn from you! We’re very grateful for the community that is evolving around the game and we want to learn more about what improvements or features would make the game even better for you.

That’s why we’re inviting you to participate in a one-on-one conversation with us. These chats will help us learn more about who you are, what you like, and what’s important to you in Small Spaces.

[h2]Let's talk![/h2]

If you want to take part in this initiative, please fill out the form [b][url=https://forms.gle/r74y3DsFd7m8Ha7L8]HERE[/url][/b].
Please note that we will only contact selected participants. And for those who get involved, we’ve prepared some small surprises.

We're all really excited to hear your thoughts and work with you to make Small Spaces something truly special!

Stay tuned for more info – and if you’ve signed up, make sure to check your email!

See you soon,
Niklas

notes.title: Christmas Update
notes.content:
It’s been one month since the release of the Small Spaces demo and I am so excited about all the wonderful designs you’ve created and shared in the [url=https://discord.gg/sBHb88EB6v]Small Spaces Discord[/url]!

Enjoy the holidays and merry Christmas!

notes.title: Small Spaces was officially announced with a trailer!
notes.content:
After developing Small Spaces for the last 5 months, it was now officially announced with a trailer by media channels like IGN and GameSpot!

As I'm making Small Spaces fully by myself it can be overwhelming to also spend hours and hours working on marketing materials. Yet, I've been getting such amazing and kind feedback from all of you until now and I hope you enjoy my new trailer just as much!

[previewyoutube=QfUR77_SUmg;full][/previewyoutube]

One milestone reached, the next one ahead: Before the end of the year you will be able to play Small Spaces for the first time in an early demo! I'm excited to hear your feedback and can't wait to see the apartments you will design.

If you want to stay updated with the development, sign up here: [url=smallspaces.dev]smallspaces.dev[/url]

Back to work now, see you then!
Niklas
